digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, LLM runner model routing
propositions: The code-review gate declares per-step model classes on five LLM-calling steps but all declarations are silently ignored at runtime, every call using the single resolved cfg.model instead
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config.model and resolves models using only self._config, causing per-step model overrides passed in RunRequest to be ignored

The step executor delivers declared model tokens (model: <class>) correctly to the resolver, but the runner layer fails to use the resolved per-step value, breaking the wiring between declaration and invocation
Usage logging lacks per-step attribution (no step id recorded alongside the op/prompt name), making it impossible to verify whether a call honored its declaration or fell through to cfg.model
Four additional per-call model configs in plan-review (verifier model, novelty pass, prerequisite ladder) are independently broken by the same root cause in the runner
